name: Platinic-Carn
description: An ocean of dust without banks. At the edge of sight, past binary sunset (multiple suns), mirage-cities rise and collapse by noon, and the light turns brutal and white.
In the calm seasons the world feels almost kind, which veterans say is exactly when it takes the careless. Slow groves of photosynthetic columns migrate centimeters a season toward the light.
Core samples from the deep crust contain isotopes with no known decay chain. The samples are stored off-world now, and studied reluctantly.
Whoever controls copper controls the approach lanes. Three factions have done the arithmetic, and only two of them are being subtle about it.
